verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents a `tofu import` command for bringing existing resources under management [opentofu-docs-8], and a community user confirms `for_each` support on `import` blocks [opentofu-comm-8]. That covers the import half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows OpenTofu generating matching configuration code for imported resources. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic configuration generation for imported resources, in-depth import workflow docs, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end import-to-code flow.
